source: docs/generative_verifier/PLAN.md section 5, frozen 2026-10-17 before any Phase 2 run
commit_record: Each campaign RECEIPT.json records the source commit and this file's sha256; TEST_FREEZE.json repeats both

data.shortcut_gate: failed (0.780 validation AUROC > 0.75); disclosed and reported as a baseline

C.target: both targets, half the samples each epoch

selection.C: mean of direct_forced and facts_forced validation verdict accuracy, one shared checkpoint

sampling.aggregate: mean P(1) at each sampled verdict token; majority vote reported alongside

primary.comparison: facts_free (B greedy) minus direct_free (A) row accuracy on the locked test
primary.unit: four-row unit for interpretation; rows paired, correctness averaged over the three seeds per row before differencing
primary.cluster: source (15 test sources); seeds never add independent scenes
primary.also_reported: unit all-correct rate for both arms

secondary: model facts + program rule (rule_reading_accuracy) versus B verdict
P(1) AUROC for every reading (invalid outputs scored 0.5)
strata: construction cell x checkpoint 0 / > 0, and the weak-shortcut subset ENTRY x checkpoint > 0
rule-flip consistency (same images, both rules correct) and color-renaming invariance
diagnostics_not_pass_criteria: per-field accuracy of protected color, target inside, goal inside, separated
counts: facts wrong (perception), facts right but verdict wrong (rule application), verdict right but facts wrong (shortcut or post-hoc text)
oracle facts: gold facts forced before Verdict:, P(1) read at the verdict token
edited premise: flip target or goal containment, regenerate from the edit; report follows-text and keeps-image rates without calling either correct
all diagnostics stratified by correct versus incorrect greedy verdict
baselines: fixed color-statistics x rule linear readout, refit on train features and scored on test in the test report
zero-shot Qwen2.5-VL-3B: direct and facts prompts
optional API model (validation only in Phase 1)

tests: t test over per-source mean differences (df 14)
statistics.minimum_detectable_effect: about 15-25 percentage points at the unit level; smaller differences are exploratory only
statistics.multiplicity: one primary comparison; secondary comparisons reported without adjustment and labelled as such

development_milestone.rule: any single arm meets all three; not sufficient for a safety gate

success.scientific: source-clustered 95% bootstrap CI of B facts_free minus A direct_free excludes 0

test_usage: Only evaluate-test after every A/B/C x seed run finishes and TEST_FREEZE.json is written; scored once per selected checkpoint
phase1: Validation only; Phase 1 results never select Phase 2 settings beyond resource requests
